title: Dual-species alkali and alkaline-earth-like optical tweezer arrays via interferometrically aligned high-NA objectives
summary: We have developed a dual-species optical tweezer array apparatus combining $^{87}\text{Rb}$ and $^{174}\text{Yb}$ atoms with a permanent hybrid Twyman-Green--Fizeau interferometer, which provides precision co-alignment of two opposing 0.6-numerical aperture (NA) objectives and the high NA beams that pass through the system. This technique is extensible to other tweezer platforms operating at high numerical aperture across widely-separated wavelengths.
